name: Nela Riehl - § 19 - Am 22
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: 19. Acknowledges the existence of skills shortages in certain sectors but stresses that responses must primarily focus on mobilising the existing workforce within the Member States, improving working conditions and wage levels, and strengthening national education and vocational training systems in line with domestic labour market needs; underlines that education and training policies fall within the competences of the Member States and must respect national specificities;
